title: loomlc plan
description: A plan for one pull request, produced by the planning step.

status.description: ready to implement, or blocked with the reasons in blockers.

pr_title.description: Conventional Commit header for the whole slice: imperative, no trailing period.

summary.description: What this slice delivers and why it's shaped this way.

files.description: The files to add or change, each with what it needs.

path.description: The file, relative to the repository root.

change.description: What this file needs: what to add, change, or remove, and why.

tests.description: The cases that must pass for this slice to be done.

deferred.description: Work deliberately left out of this slice, each item a task someone could pick up.

blockers.description: What stops the work, when status is blocked. Empty otherwise.
